Numbers & logic · 3 lessons

Make numbers easier to work with

Build three reusable mental-maths tools: adjust a number, split a multiplication and combine familiar percentages.

By Biel Sardà · Published 30 Sept 2026 · Suggest a correction

What you will learn

Begin by changing a calculation without changing its answer. Then use that idea to split multiplication into parts, before combining parts of a whole.

Before you start: Comfort with basic addition, subtraction and multiplication.

  • Explain the correction after rounding a number.
  • Multiply by 11 and handle a carry.
  • Build percentages from tenths, halves and quarters.

Keep these ideas handy

Compensation
Adjusting a calculation, then correcting for that change.
Distributive property
Multiplying a sum by multiplying its parts and adding the results.
Percent
A proportion expressed per hundred.
